sound._doc: Town sound through the shared Synth (scripts/fx/synth.gd). kinds maps a town event to a Synth kind (configs/synth.json): tier_up = the walls start drawing; raise_hold = the crypt hold began (the absorb, it cannot be cut on release); raise_grow = Keep was pressed and the rings start to bend onto the outline (the collapse starts); raise_done = the collapse landed; trade_blip = a sale's arc, the short high soft streak (at most one per trade_min_gap_s); beat = each Pulse beat (skipped while muted). Mute and volume are the Synth's (AudioPrefs, M).

text._muster_doc: The idle muster (view_hud.split.muster_to): FLOOD, Vei's queue, unless the Muster stance sends it to WAR. muster_word follows its rate in the workers cell; muster_tip is that row's tooltip.

muster_tip.flood: Idle hands beyond the idle cap muster to FLOOD: they join Vei's queue. The Muster stance sends them to WAR, your forts, instead.
muster_tip.war: The Muster stance is on: idle hands muster to WAR and stream to your forts.

guide._doc: Phase I clarity (town-i M1, Shawn's checklist items 10-11; TownGuide). why: per building, one line: what it does for you → the part of the loop it feeds. how: act names the buildings the player uses by hand, and where; every other building works on its own, `staffed` when buildings.json gives it jobs, else `passive`. paid_line heads the Build tab's catalog; essence_line sits by every essence count in town, and essence_short is the HUD's essence count (essence_line its tooltip). jargon: the glossary's one-line meaning of a word, the tooltip at each place the word shows (mint on the Raising Pit's rates, husk in the Crypt tab, phylactery in the Backups tab). goal: the first goal in town, the first step whose `until` isn't met yet (built: a building of that id placed, under construction included; fort_taken: any fort held now or with flipped_count > 0); none once all are met, and none past the early `tiers` (a first goal is for a new game). {fort} is the first dungeon's name (view_realm forts' first_dungeon), else fort_any.

why.crypt: The slab raises big undead for your raids and sieges. Levels raise the cap.
why.raising_pit: Turns hauled bodies into undead, your mint → workers, WAR to your forts, FLOOD to Vei.
why.charnel_house: Hauls bodies home from your forts and stores them → bodies for the pits and the mill.
why.market: Your living buy at its stalls → gold for every build and upgrade.
why.house: Room for more living → more buyers at the Market → more gold.
why.well: Morale and room for living → the living stay and buy.
why.bakery: Morale and room for living → the living stay and buy.
why.inn: Draws new living to town, with morale and room → more buyers, more gold.
why.bone_mill: Grinds bodies into bone → bone for buildings.
why.forge: Smiths toughen all your undead; each step needs relics → fewer die holding your forts.
why.graveyard: Stores more bodies, and your workers last longer → more hands.
why.embalmer: Your workers last longer before they rot → more hands for jobs and WAR.
why.stables: Faster hauls → bodies come home sooner.
why.chapel_of_vats: Grows clones in its vats → backups keep Relish alive.
why.ossuary_tower: Crafts phylactery charges and simulacra → backups keep Relish alive.
why.guildhall: One more stance slot → more say in how your undead behave on their own.
why.watchtower: Exact warden tells and death risk in fort hints → safer raids.
why.walls: Room for living and morale. Your town needs it to reach Town tier.
why.plaza: Morale → the living stay and buy.
why.statue: Morale, and Relish's deaths shake the town less.
why.reliquary: Bigger relic and essence stores → more saved for buildings and backups.

act.crypt: You use it: Crypt tab, while Relish is home. Lay a husk, slot remnants, hold to raise.
act.chapel_of_vats: You use it: Backups tab. Staff a vat and it grows a clone.
act.ossuary_tower: You use it: Backups tab, Craft. It's paid in essence from your raids.
act.guildhall: You use it: Stances tab. Its extra slot lets one more stance run at once.

how.staffed: Works on its own: your undead staff its jobs (order them in the Jobs tab).
how.passive: Works on its own: no staff needed.

guide.paid_line: Buildings cost gold and bone, which your town makes. Some, and higher levels, also need relics: raid a fort.
guide.essence_line: Essence comes home from your raids. It pays for backups here at the Ossuary Tower, never for buildings.

jargon.mint: Mint: the undead your Raising Pits make each second. The map's valve splits it into WORK (your town's jobs), WAR (your forts) and FLOOD (Vei's queue).
jargon.husk: Husk: the frame a big undead is raised in. Lay it on the crypt slab and slot remnants to shape it. Raids bring husks home, or you can craft one from bone and remnants.
jargon.phylactery: Phylactery charge: revives Relish in place, at most once per dungeon. The Ossuary Tower crafts it from essence.

steps.text: build a Bone Mill. Bone and gold pay for buildings, and your town makes both.
take your first fort. Return to the realm, raid {fort} and break its warden.

muster_names._doc: Where the idle muster goes, named as the valve names it (view_hud.split.muster_to): the HUD's idle line and the forecast.

replay._doc: The welcome-back replay (TownReplay, Q-f): once per away report in a session, each build that finished while you were away flashes in order, first_beats then flash_beats apart (Pulse beats), under a strip in the dock (over the tabs, clear of every lot) of the report's build and ready lines (at most max_lines). The strip hides hold_s after the last flash (0: until closed). acts: the button on a line with somewhere to go.

queue_text._doc: The Build tab's queue (view_town().queue and its commands). A gated entry waits in its place (IDLE §5): gate_wait words its gate (wait_slot: a buildable entry past the first queue_max slot-holders, waiting for one), `skipped` any other skip (lot_taken and the like). affordable_in_s (R2) sets the start: 0 now, > 0 a wait, -1 never at today's income (with the row's starved/lever, starved_why). queued_ok reports a queued entry's own affordable_in_s.
queue_text.title: Queue: builds start on their own, in order, while you're away too
queue_text.queue_moved: The queue moved on (that entry started or changed place): nothing was sent. Look again.
